title: Induction
coreMove: Use Induction as the warning label, then make the specific correction before the choice moves forward.
sourcePressure: The source sidecar and official source notes frame Induction as a specific decision error around induction, unbroken run, past data. Traceable support includes Nassim Taleb - though he used a Thanksgiving turkey.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Induction as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: use induction as the warning label, then make the specific correction before the choice moves forward.

hook: Do not open with a definition of Induction.
Do not use a generic panic-at-a-meeting opener.
counterintuition: Avoid the reusable shape where the obvious answer is wrong and the opposite is true.
Do not make Induction sound like ordinary carelessness.
examples: No coffee mug, classroom whiteboard, bus depot, radiator, bike helmet, or narrow kitchen shell.
No example may skip the specific mechanics of Induction.
